description: This PHP source file is part of the ADODB library and defines the ADODB_DataDict class, which provides methods for database schema manipulation such as creating tables, columns, indexes, and altering database structures. It also includes utility functions for parsing SQL-like argument strings and managing database-specific SQL syntax.

classes.name: ADODB_DataDict
classes.description: A class providing comprehensive methods for database schema management, including creating, altering, and renaming tables and columns, managing indexes, and handling database-specific SQL generation.

methods.name: GetCommentSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL to get comments for a specified table column (stub implementation).

methods.name: SetCommentSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL to set comments for a specified table column (stub implementation).

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Returns the list of tables in the database.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Returns metadata about columns in a specified table.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Returns primary key information for a specified table.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Returns index information for a specified table.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Provides type information, delegating to ADORecordSet's MetaType.

methods.name: NameQuote
methods.description: Quotes a database object name, considering existing quotes and allowed brackets.

methods.name: TableName
methods.description: Generates a fully qualified table name, optionally including schema.

methods.name: ExecuteSQLArray
methods.description: Executes an array of SQL statements, optionally continuing on error.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Returns the actual data type based on metadata.

methods.name: CreateDatabase
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to create a database.

methods.name: CreateIndexSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for creating an index.

methods.name: DropIndexSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for dropping an index.

methods.name: SetSchema
methods.description: Sets the schema name for the database.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for adding columns to a table.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for altering a column.

methods.name: RenameColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for renaming a column.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for dropping columns.

methods.name: DropTableSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for dropping a table.

methods.name: RenameTableSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for renaming a table.

methods.name: CreateTableSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for creating a new table with columns and constraints.

methods.name: _GenFields
methods.description: Parses field definitions into SQL lines and primary key info.

methods.name: _GetSize
methods.description: Returns datatype size specifications.

methods.name: _CreateSuffix
methods.description: Creates SQL suffixes for column constraints such as DEFAULT and NOT NULL.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Builds index creation SQL statements.

methods.name: _DropAutoIncrement
methods.description: Stub for dropping auto-increment features.

methods.name: _TableSQL
methods.description: Generates CREATE TABLE SQL, including primary keys and constraints.

methods.name: _Triggers
methods.description: Stub for generating triggers if needed for auto-increment emulation.

methods.name: _Options
methods.description: Sanitizes and normalizes SQL option arrays.

methods.name: ChangeTableSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to alter a table's columns, either creating or modifying structure.
